annotations.title: Look up a public FiveM server

description: Looks up a public FiveM server by cfx.re join code/link (e.g. cfx.re/join/abc123) or public host:port. Returns what the server or the Cfx server list publishes: hostname, player count, slots, artifact/build, OneSync, tags, public variables and resources. Private and local addresses are refused; offline servers are reported as unreachable. Player names and identifiers are not returned.
name: lookup_server
title: Look up a public FiveM server
